text_block_list.text:
Inside the academy grounds, I spotted Rice 
Shower trembling for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Kris S-san's Trainer... Um... Over 
there—

Following Rice Shower's gaze... I saw 
Symboli Kris S staring intently in our 
direction.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-Lately... Kris S-san has been staring 
intently at Rice from time to time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe... without realizing it, Rice did 
something terrible... and that's why 
they're mad at me...
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I hope... that's the case—

Afterward. I caught sight of Rice Shower 
training out on the track, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whew... *pant*...! I'm exhausted...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh!? R-Rice's drink bottle... the 
bottom of it is cracked...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Was it when I dropped it yesterday...? 
Ugh, it's completely spilled out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? K-Kris S-san!? I'm s-so sorry, I'm 
so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice must have caused so much trouble for 
Kris S-san...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Calm down.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyai!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Take this.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? T-This is... for Rice?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ ――A token of my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The other day... during training... I... 
also forgot... my water... but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...The joy I felt—back then. I've always 
wanted... to thank you for it."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... the reason you've been watching 
Rice lately... is because you wanted to 
repay me...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... I-I'm so sorry! Even though you 
did that, I just assumed you were mad at 
me and got scared......!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Never mind that—it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"If I could return... the joy of that 
water— —then that's enough."
choice_data_list:
Water is an important source of strength, 
after all.

Water is an important source of strength, 
you know.
Such a dutiful return gift, so like you.

What a conscientious return gift, just 
like you.

text_block_list.text:
"If I could return... the joy of that 
water— —then that's enough."

after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. Water is—supreme.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—to me—a debt of water— can only 
be repaid—with water.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um! Kris S-san! Well, I thought some 
terrible things about you too, so I wanted 
to make it up to you, if I could..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything... Rice can do to help? 
Like, um... a training partner... or 
something...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...Then— will you be—my running partner?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

And so, with the misunderstanding cleared 
up, Symboli Kris S was able to repay the 
favor in the best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Here. Drink... try it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Thank you very much, Kris S-san!
(*Gulp, gulp*)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...*Pfft*, it's delicious...! Kris S-san, 
your water is so delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

And so, with the misunderstanding cleared 
up, Symboli Kris S was able to repay the 
favor in the best possible way.
